definition: a chest of drawers for clothes
description: In a bright bedroom with a tall window and white curtains, a young woman with curly hair, a black slip dress and a black leather jacket stands beside a tall dark-wood chest of drawers with brass handles. Its drawers are pulled open and stuffed with jeans, jumpers and scarves. She throws a bundle of colourful scarves into the air, pulls a pair of jeans out of a drawer and tosses it, then pulls out a striped sock and holds it up. An unmade bed covered in clothes and tulips in a vase complete the room.
